description: This file defines a terminal-based test reporter class for the Playwright testing framework, including methods for formatting test results, handling output, and generating summaries. It also includes utility functions for error stack parsing, path resolution, and attachment grouping.

classes.name: TerminalReporter
classes.description: A class implementing a terminal-based test reporter for Playwright, capable of formatting and outputting test results, summaries, and handling output streams.

methods.name: formatSingleResult
methods.description: Formats a single test result for display, including outcome and error details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats a detailed failure report for a test, including attachments and error messages.

methods.name: formatRetry
methods.description: Formats output indicating a test retry.

methods.name: quotePathIfNeeded
methods.description: Quotes a file path if it contains whitespace.

methods.name: markErrorsAsReported
methods.description: Marks errors in a test result as reported to avoid duplicate reporting.

methods.name: formatResultFailure
methods.description: Generates error details for a test result, including stack trace and message.

methods.name: relativeFilePath
methods.description: Computes relative file path based on screen resolve setting.

methods.name: relativeTestPath
methods.description: Gets relative path for a test's file location.

methods.name: stepSuffix
methods.description: Generates suffix string for test step path.

methods.name: formatTestTitle
methods.description: Creates a formatted test title string with location and tags.

methods.name: formatTestHeader
methods.description: Creates a formatted header for a test, optionally including error step path.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats an error message and stack trace for display.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Creates a separator line for display.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Indents lines with a specified prefix.

methods.name: prepareErrorStack
methods.description: Parses and prepares an error stack trace.

methods.name: characterWidth
methods.description: Calculates display width of a character considering East Asian Width.

methods.name: stringWidth
methods.description: Calculates display width of a string.

methods.name: suffixOfWidth
methods.description: Gets suffix of a string fitting within a specified width.

methods.name: fitToWidth
methods.description: Truncates a line to fit within a specified width, adding ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: resolveFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves a path from environment variable.

methods.name: resolveOutputFile
methods.description: Determines output file path based on reporter name and options.

methods.name: groupAttachments
methods.description: Groups test attachments by filename pattern into expected, actual, diff, previous.
